question_text: An investigator is studying the effects of zinc deprivation on cancer cell proliferation. To test this hypothesis, tumor cells are cultured on media containing low and high concentrations of zinc. During the experiment, a labeled oligonucleotide probe is used to identify the presence of a known transcription factor. The investigator most likely used which of the following laboratory techniques?
